| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Models/Recipe.cs` | Recipe data model |
| `Models/RecipeSubmission.cs` | Form model with validation |
| `Services/RecipeService.cs` | Singleton service with 9 seed recipes across 5 categories |
| `Pages/Home.razor` | Homepage with category cards (SSR) |
| `Pages/Categories.razor` | Category listing page (SSR) |
| `Pages/CategoryPage.razor` | Recipes filtered by category with star previews (SSR) |
| `Pages/RecipePage.razor` | Full recipe detail with ingredients & steps (SSR) |
| `Pages/StarRating.razor` | Interactive ⭐ rating widget (`@rendermode InteractiveServer`) |
| `Pages/SubmitRecipe.razor` | Interactive form with validation (`@rendermode InteractiveServer`) |

**Render mode strategy:** Most pages are static SSR for performance. Only the `StarRating` component and `SubmitRecipe` page opt into `InteractiveServer` since they need click/form handling.

Run with `cd RecipeHub && dotnet run`.
